crossRefs.note: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: “Isn’t Yahweh in Zion?…
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh…
They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.
They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will…
Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.
Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.
Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
“Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and bring you good news, that you…
“You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and…
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore…
The idols shall utterly pass away.
I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble…
I will stretch out my hand against Judah, and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of…
It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land…

translations.web: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.
translations.bsb: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
translations.kjv: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
translations.asv: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
